library.name: 1.300 Animações de Treinos
library.permission: Paul confirmed full reuse permission for the exercise animations on 2026-10-23.
inventory: The seven muscle folders hold 762 GIF files, 727 of them unique by SHA-1. Each GIF is a named, single-lift loop of 12 frames at 360, 720 or 1080 px square.

'+400 Animações musculação e funcional - VERSÃO ATUALIZADA' holds 406 MP4 files with the same SHA-1 set as ' 1.000 Exercise GIF Library/1° BIBLIOTECA - GIFs PREMIUM DE EJERCICIOS'. They are 345 unique videos.

Each MP4 is a 720x1280, about 23 second reel that shows several lifts in a row, each first done wrong (red cross) and then right (green tick). The file names are generic ('Treinos (273).mp4'). No MP4 is used: one file never shows one lift alone.
